responsibility: Implements RTL instruction recognition and validation support around machine descriptions. It initializes recognizer state, checks asm operand legality, manages tentative and grouped RTL changes with re-recognition/constraint validation, drives operand extraction and alternative selection, supports insn splitting at several RTL pipeline stages, and maintains target-specific recognizer caches and hook state that bridge generic RTL transforms with generated insn-recognition tables.
same_name_distinction: Implements recognizer-state initialization, asm operand checking, change validation, insn splitting passes, and target-specific recognizer cache maintenance around generated machine-description tables; unlike gcc/recog.h, it contains the runtime recognition and transformation code rather than the shared recognizer types and declarations.
